name: ask-codex-raycast
title: AI CLI in Raycast
description: 在 Raycast 中使用本机 AI CLI，各家拥有独立命令、设置与会话。Native chats for your installed AI CLIs, with independent commands, settings, and sessions.
author: bbfss

preferences.name: uiLanguage
preferences.title: 界面语言 / Interface Language
preferences.description: 聊天、启动器与插件内设置默认跟随系统语言，也可手动指定。更改后重新打开命令生效。Language for chats, launcher, and CLI Settings. Follow the system or choose a language, then reopen the command.

preferences.name: autoDetectCli
preferences.title: CLI 自动检测 / CLI Detection
preferences.label: 自动查找已安装的 CLI / Automatically find installed CLIs
preferences.description: 检查 PATH 与常见安装位置，手动路径优先。关闭后需为每家 CLI 填写路径。Search PATH and known locations; manual paths take priority. Turn off to require explicit paths.

preferences.name: codexModelStrategy
preferences.title: Codex 默认策略 / Defaults
preferences.description: 沿用上次的模型与思考强度，或固定使用“CLI 设置 → Codex”中选择的配置。切回沿用上次时仍保留固定配置。Use the last model and effort, or a fixed pair from CLI Settings → Codex. Switching back preserves the fixed pair.

preferences.name: liveSearch
preferences.title: Codex 网页搜索 / Web Search
preferences.description: 允许 Codex CLI 实时搜索网页；其他 CLI 使用各自的设置。Allow Codex live web search. Other CLIs use their own settings.
preferences.label: 启用实时网页搜索 / Enable live web search

preferences.name: sandboxMode
preferences.title: Codex 权限范围 / Sandbox Mode
preferences.description: 设置 Codex 的文件访问权限。Antigravity 使用自己的规划与沙箱参数。Codex file permissions. Antigravity uses its own plan and sandbox flags.

data.title: 可修改工作目录 / Workspace write

preferences.name: workingDirectory
preferences.title: 工作目录 / Working Directory
preferences.description: 可选，填写项目文件夹的绝对路径；留空使用 CLI 的默认目录。Optional absolute project directory. Leave empty for the CLI default.

preferences.name: codexPath
preferences.title: Codex CLI 路径 / Path
preferences.description: 可选，填写 codex、codex.exe 或 codex.cmd 的绝对路径；留空自动检测（需开启自动检测）。Optional absolute executable path. Leave empty for automatic detection when enabled.
preferences.placeholder: 可选：可执行文件绝对路径 / Optional executable path

preferences.name: agyPath
preferences.title: Antigravity CLI 路径 / Path
preferences.description: 可选，填写 agy 可执行文件的绝对路径；留空自动检测（需开启自动检测）。沿用本机 CLI 登录。Optional absolute agy path; leave empty for detection when enabled. Uses your CLI sign-in.

preferences.name: qoderPath
preferences.title: Qoder CLI 路径 / Path
preferences.description: 可选，填写可执行文件或 Node 入口的绝对路径；留空自动检测（需开启自动检测）。使用该 CLI 自身的登录。Optional absolute executable or Node entrypoint path; leave empty for detection when enabled. Uses this CLI’s own sign-in.
